title: Career roadmap · Social Media Manager
summary: A Social Media Manager plans, creates, publishes and analyses social content while managing communities, campaigns, brand voice and audience growth across digital platforms.

facts.Timeline assumption: This roadmap assumes a standard 3-year BBA. If a 4-year honours/research variant is available, use the additional year for advanced social analytics, paid media, creator strategy, internships and a major digital-marketing project.

about.label: Course alignment
about.text: Social Media Manager is directly aligned with the BBA – Digital Marketing pathway.

horizons.question: What can I enter now?
horizons.output: Build content creation, social-media strategy, copywriting, analytics, community management and digital-campaign skills.

horizons.question: How should I specialise?
horizons.output: Specialise in brand social, performance social, creator/influencer marketing, B2B social, community growth or social-commerce.

horizons.question: How should I evolve?
horizons.output: Progress toward Senior Social Media Manager, Social Media Lead, Content Strategy Lead, Brand Manager or Growth Manager.

horizons.question: How can I remain relevant?
horizons.output: Combine brand strategy, audience intelligence, AI-assisted content workflows, creator ecosystems and commercial growth.

blocks.text: Alternative routes:

PhD routes
Potential research areas include:
A PhD is primarily relevant to academic research, teaching and specialised consumer/media research.

The long-term goal should be to move from managing social channels to owning audience and brand strategy. AI will increasingly automate parts of content production, scheduling, social listening and reporting. Senior professionals will therefore need stronger capabilities in brand positioning, community strategy, creator ecosystems, customer psychology, experimentation and commercial decision-making.
